title: Rules and precautions
line: The less sure the trigger, the less it may do.

words.means: data you set. It is triggered by a fact, it reads only facts, it is exact, and it may do anything you wrote in it.
data you set. It is triggered by a report or an opinion, so it can be wrong, and it takes only protective actions.
the request waits at the boundary for the answer.
nothing waits. The trigger is something already seen, and only the computer is left to act on.
one thing a model's reply asks for: a command, a file edit, a search.

test.question: In the middle of the night a classifier wrongly thinks your agent is working against you. What is the worst its precaution can do, and what can it never do?
test.answer: The worst is lost time. Main is paused until you look, and you resume it. Nothing that was running is ended and nothing is erased, because a precaution never stops, restores or drops a computer. And it can never let anything through: it cannot allow, resume or give a secret. Only you, or a rule you set, can do those.
